summary: ServiceNow Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a $4 billion unsecured term loan credit agreement on April 17, 2026, to finance a portion of the cash consideration for its acquisition of Armis Security Ltd. The term loan matures on October 16, 2026, with interest at alternate base rate or term SOFR plus a margin based on credit ratings, and includes customary covenants and a potential six-month extension at lender discretion. JPMorgan Chase acted as administrative agent. The acquisition terms (price, premium, target advisors) and board recommendation were not disclosed. Watch for regulatory clearance and financing risk given short maturity.
